name: flowers
description: a patch of wilted roses, their petals brown and curling. but one bush defies the decay — a single red rose bush blooms vibrantly, as if it's june instead of october.

params.success_message: the single red rose bush seems out of place in this garden of decay. as you lean closer, you notice a small brass plaque at its base, nearly hidden by thorns: 'for our eleanor, who loved roses. gone but never forgotten. — mother and father.' this is a grave.
